Euromaster is hiring!
 Contract Type: Unlimited
 Location: Voluntari
 Mission
 Guarantee the quality, reliability and update of the master data linked to Fleet Management Master Data streams activities assigned to EBS.
Point of contact for any queries concerning Fleet Management activities received by email, phone or other tools.
Guarantee the preparation and updating the documentation of all Fleet Management processes.
Usage of the existing procedures to perform the daily activities.
Strong understanding of the systems used, how the dates are working and how the data is exported to the other systems.
Contribute to data cleansing activities and maintain the accuracy of the database according to the business rules.
Strong collaboration and involvement in streamlining initiatives.
Coordination of a range of tasks in the area of functional stream.
Mentoring of experienced and junior persons in the stream.
Perform any task autonomously or in collaboration with the stream expert.
Identifies key issues and patterns from incomplete or inaccurate data.
Takes a broad perspective to problems and identifies new, less obvious solutions with focus on outcome.
 Key Expected Achievments
Analyze, create and / or update Master Data for Fleet Management stream including all related activities and processes.
Use existing procedures to solve daily tasks, resolve specific situations and support the colleagues from the countries (headquarters, service centers etc.).
Write the SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) for the Fleet Management Master Data processes and update them in real time.
Share the knowledge within the team and collaborate with the other departments involved in the end-to-end process.
Understand the business context and the specificities of each country.
Respect the deadlines, consistency & accuracy of the data maintained for Fleet Management Master Data processes.
Ensure business continuity during planned/unplanned absence by providing training for back-up/new colleagues.
Actively participate to trainings and workshops.
Identify opportunities to improve the processes under their area of responsibility; actively participate in process improvement or efficiency projects.
 Fleet Manangement
Create and set up a contract (SAP and TYC);
Update a contract (SAP and TYC);
Close a contract;
Update the technical advisers portfolio;
Key User Tyrecheck Report;
Fleet Update (Vehicle Creation, Exit and Transfer);
Vehicle Creation;
Vehicle Update;
Vehicle valuation;
ETL Flow Checks;
Exports & reports (frequently or ad-hoc);
Interface errors management;
IS/IT errors;
Training for new joiners.
 What We’re Offering
Competitive salary + performance bonus
Christmas, Easter & International Women’s Day bonuses
Life insurance coverage
Financial support for life-celebration events
7Card – sport & wellness access
Private medical care + 24/7 medical hotline
Meal tickets + canteen subsidy
Unlimited access to learning platforms, trainings & conferences
Extra vacation days based on length of service
Birthday day off – celebrate yourself
 How We Recruit
 Once you submit your application, one of our recruiters reviews it. If your profile fits our role:
We have a HR Screen
We hold assessments to evaluate your language skills and competencies
We meet in a face-to-face (or online, depending on the context) interview with an expert and the hiring manager
